author: agent
statement: Run 105 completes all twelve lots with 100% good yield but only 83.3% first-pass yield: two fixed etch-cell-layer-2 excursions are repaired, with zero scrap, escape, or lost output. The spatially observed etch-l2 cell is input-wait dominated at 31.7% utilization, with zero blocked, unpowered, or failed time; four jobs use normal closed-loop-control and eight use recovery closed-loop-fast-4-5. Capacity duplication and local transport changes therefore do not address the observed mechanism.
